title: Bug 639857: Project journal ignores task-level Bill-to Customer for pricing
summary: Project journal pricing now respects task-level bill-to customer settings when multiple customers are enabled, matching the behavior of project planning lines.
key_points: Job Journal Line price calculation now checks task billing method
Uses task-level bill-to customer instead of only job-level when multiple customers feature is active
Aligns journal pricing logic with planning line pricing logic
Test coverage added for multiple customer billing scenarios
quote: when Task Billing Method is not "One customer", use the Job Task Bill-to Customer/Contact
